ledger.claim: The tripping of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is itself an enumerated escalation trigger under POL-NS-09(d), and POL-NS-09 fires where ANY of its triggers holds, so escalation to a human reviewer is mandatory on this record and the automated pipeline issues no monetary ruling.

Escalation under POL-NS-09 is terminal and the disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded; EV-FARE-00207 already records payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00, so the rider is not made to carry the contested SGD 4.00 while the reviewer decides.

POL-NS-07 directs the escalation packet to instruct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, so the escalation carries a defined remedy rather than leaving the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line unresolved: that line is the sum the reviewer is directed to return.

The rider's own device track does not support the assertion that she came down: EV-GPS-00207 places her fixes about 1.9 km from the pin throughout the window with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0, and the rider does not press POL-NS-04, whose limb (a) requires a coordinating message the chat log does not contain. Rider presence is not an element of the escalation trigger, so the disposition of the fee turns on POL-NS-07 and POL-NS-09, not on where the rider stood.

EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING, carrying issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0 - no advisory covers Woodlands Ave 6 in this window - and its absence is itself citable: POL-NS-06(i) requires an advisory that is present and populated, so the accumulation limb cannot be run at all and the driver's dwell rests solely on the single qualifying in-geofence run of 507 seconds that EV-GPS-00207 measures.

Limbs (a) and (d) of the baseline no-show test are met on the face of the trip record: it carries a driver 'arrived' event at 06:41:20, records no boarding and no trip start, and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 06:49:37 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with status CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER.

The arrival geofence test is satisfied many times over: the trace carries 52 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius - the driver's nearest fix being 14.47 m from the pin - on unbroken 10 second telemetry with 100 percent coverage and no accuracy filtering, against POL-NS-02's requirement of 3 consecutive in-radius fixes.

Limb (b) is met at the correct moment: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 06:41:10, ten seconds before the 06:41:20 'arrived' event, so the driver was already inside the radius when he marked arrival and the clock runs from GPS entry, not from the tap.

Limb (c) is met with room to spare: the driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 507 seconds, from 06:41:10 to 06:49:37, exceeding the 300 second STANDARD minimum by 207 seconds, the shortfall figure being -207.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at 06:41:20 the driver was already inside the geofence and stationary - his nearest fix is 14.47 m from the pin and his reported speeds include 0.0 km/h - so he was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor travelling at 15 km/h or above.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell of 507 seconds exceeds the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so the cancellation was not premature and the shortfall is negative, at -207 seconds.

POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is neither available nor needed here, and the absent advisory assists nobody: EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING - issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, admissibility weight 0.0, no payload - which makes limb (i) unavailable and makes it an argument against nobody, while the trace shows one single unbroken in-geofence run (run_count 1), so no summing of separate intervals is required in any event.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged: it governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, whereas the driver's fixes place him inside the 50 m radius throughout, nearest 14.47 m from the pin; the trip record also shows a single registered pickup point, so there is no pin-ambiguity case for the rider to build on.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails because all four chat entries are from the system or the driver and the rider sent nothing at all during the waiting window, and limb (b) fails in any event because the driver placed an in-app voice call at 06:45:10 which the rider left unanswered.

The rider's own account that he 'did come down, just a few minutes later' is contradicted by his own device: the rider track carries 118 fixes, none of them qualifying, at a minimum distance of 1,894 m and a mean of 1,900 m from the pickup pin for the whole window - roughly 1.9 km away at another block, far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

The fee is therefore legitimately chargeable and the rider's claim for his money back is not supported: POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs, no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line in the fare breakdown stands.
On POL-NS-01 satisfied, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the cancellation fee - SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 charged - the residual SGD 0.80 being the platform service fee.

I do not put that compensation beyond the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check, because on this record it trips: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 over 61 completed trips in 30 days is 11.5 percent, above the 8 percent rate limb. Both limbs are met on the two profile fields the clause names, so compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09 - a profile-based anti-farming safeguard and the packet direction it carries, not a finding that this rider was present at Blk 682.

Escalation is not a refund to the rider and must not be read as one: under POL-NS-09 the disputed cancellation fee is placed on hold - neither collected nor refunded - while human review is pending, and the fare ledger already shows payment_status PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider's request for his SGD 4.00 is not granted by the automated pipeline.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.00 is not released by the automated pipeline, but the case goes to a human reviewer with a direction that the fee be refunded to you. The driver reached Blk 682 and held position inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup zone from 06:41:10 until he cancelled at 06:49:37 — 507 seconds, comfortably past the 300-second minimum — and he cancelled under RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 are met. Your account that you 'did come down, just a few minutes later' is not supported: your own phone's GPS places you about 1.9 km from the pin for the whole window, with 0 qualifying fixes near the pickup, and no locating message from you appears in the chat. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate you — you sent nothing coordinating, and the driver's in-app call at 06:45:10 went unanswered. POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) is not engaged because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and POL-NS-05 is not engaged because the arrival marker was true — he was 14.47 m from the pin and stationary, not over 300 m away or moving at 15 km/h. On the merits the fee stood.

To the driver: your four limbs under POL-NS-01 are made out, and POL-NS-07 would have paid you 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, i.e. SGD 3.20, leaving SGD 0.80 as the platform service fee. That payment is withheld. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check is run on the two trailing-30-day counters your clause names, and it trips on both limbs: no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (4 or more), and 7 of 61 completed trips is 11.5 percent, above the 8 percent rate. Because the check trips, compensation is withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). The disputed SGD 4.00 is held — the ledger already shows payment_status PENDING and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — and the escalation packet directs the reviewer to refund it to the rider. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (0) is not the field this test reads and was not used against you.

One further note: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), which makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb unavailable. It is not needed here, because the driver's dwell is a single unbroken in-geofence run of 507 seconds, and the absence is not used against either party. All deciding artifacts (trip record, GPS trace, driver profile, fare breakdown) carry full weight 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full, the fee being held rather than collected or refunded while review is pending.
